input.title: Women's Pickleball – Booked Solid Crewneck Sweatshirt
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

A cheerful retiree in a sun visor sits on a courtside bench with a thermos and a wall calendar where every square holds a little paddle, and the shirt says BOOKED SOLID (pickleball). This pickleball sweatshirt is for the newly retired mom, grandma or club regular whose whole week is open play.

The print shows a 1960s woman in a striped sun hat and a patterned cardigan holding a calendar of tiny paddles, with a steel thermos beside her and a red paddle and a ball leaning against the bench. BOOKED SOLID is in red slab capitals above and (pickleball) in navy script below.

Wear it to morning open play, a clubhouse lunch or a cold bleacher day, and give it to the friend who says she is retired but has no free time. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex crewneck sweatshirt fit
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband; no hood, no pockets
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 2 colors: Sand, Navy

Questions

What is the Booked Solid crewneck sweatshirt?
It is a women's-leaning crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. printed with a retiree and a calendar full of paddles, lettered BOOKED SOLID (pickleball). It is a Gildan 18000 in 8 oz cotton-poly fleece, with no hood and no pockets, so it layers easily over a court shirt.

How does the crewneck sweatshirt fit?
This Graphic Tees Co. crewneck is a classic unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL with a ribbed collar, cuffs and waistband. Order your usual size for a regular fit or size up for a roomier layer over a tee. If the size is off, the first exchange is free.

How warm is it and how do I wash it?
The sweatshirt is 50% cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz, a midweight layer for a cool court or bleachers. Wash it inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. That keeps the red and navy inks from fading and the fleece soft after many washes.

Is it a good pickleball gift for a retiree?
Yes. It suits the newly retired friend, mom or grandma whose calendar is all open play. From Graphic Tees Co. it costs $34.99, comes in Sand and Navy, and the free size exchange makes it safe to give for a retirement party, birthday or Christmas.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. pickleball sweatshirt should arrive before Christmas. Each sweatshirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.
